Note 1: Data URLs are not immune to history logging, so you will need to delete history manually.


Note2: If the page closes immediately after opening a data URL, try opening 100+ tabs and open the URL again.

Self Hosting Guide
You are free to fork and self-host the NettleWeb website if none of the links work for you. It is strongly recommended to do this at home. Your activities could be tracked easily if you are using a managed device or network.


To do so, simply follow the steps below. If you have problems, you could ask for help on our Discord support channel.


1. Create a GitHub account if you don’t have one already.
2. Go to NettleWeb’s official repository and click ‘fork’ at the top-right corner. (Please also click the star button. It helps a lot with Google search ranking.)
3. Change the repository name to ‘username.github.io’ where ‘username’ is your actual GitHub username.
4. Click ‘create fork’ and wait for the process to complete.
5. On your forked repository, go to settings->pages.
6. Select branch ‘Main’ and click save.


Your self-hosted website should now be accessible in the URL shown.
Don’t forget to update your fork frequently to match the upstream, otherwise you might not be able to connect to the backend and use features like proxy and ChatGPT.


If you are still unable to connect to the backend, please see the backend mirroring guide below for workarounds.




Backend Mirroring Guide

Introduction to TINYURL




TinyURL is a tool that lets you share and save Google Docs and other links without having to put the whole link…


(example: https://docs.google.com/document/d/12b4Kkzs8qyFH_mfyjUDV8Vc2NqY1Er4T6pNCoF25WY8/edit?usp=drivesdk)


Go to TinyURL.com, and put in a big link. Add a name to it…


(example:
tinyurl.com/drstranges gamedoc)


And you can write down the short name, or paste it into a smaller text box without having to use the whole link.


If TinyURL is blocked, it will block your page before it redirects. 
If you have a TinyURL link that leads you to a website you want, you can use unshorten.it and paste in the TinyURL link to copy the longer link that should be unblocked.

WRITING TIPS 1
There Are 4 Different Chapters In Each Writing Tips!!
1: Creating Characters
When writing characters, don’t just rush into it and make a name, age, birthday and think that’s all. No, your character is a REAL person in this story. You need their name, age, birthday, height, weight, personality, favorite movie, everything a real person has(unless like, you’re making a spirit, or something)


I’ve done this before, and TRUST ME, when you just give a character a name and write it, things will go TERRIBLY.


It’s like your character is having an identity crisis! One moment you’ll make them a happy jolly character that’s always excited, the next moment they’re nonchalant, quiet, sarcastic, and bored.


Writing a story isn’t just done in a week, not if you’re creative. Maybe write this person down, draw them out a couple times, even if you’re terrible at drawing(so am I…) At least you’ll have an idea on what this person/thing looks like, and how they act.


Give them a style, a personality, make a google doc on each character you make, how they act, talk, walk, and style.


I know it takes a while to do this, but TRUST ME, it makes writing your character SO MUCH easier, and it’s like they’re a REAL PERSON. 


Don’t just slap a name on them, give em a face and that’s it! No one knows this character better than you do, no one can write out a character like YOU can, you need to make your character like they’re a part of your everyday life!
Write down little quirky things they do, maybe a catchphrase they say,or a certain thing they do everyday. 
For example: Tengen always says “That’s flashy!!”, that would be a catchphrase.


All I’m saying is, making characters isn’t just a name and a face, this is a real person with a real personality. There are no rules and limitations for “how” their personality needs to be!


You have full control of this character! Use it to your advantage!

3: How to write manipulative characters


When writing a manipulative character, you should do LOTS of research, good thing you’re reading this :D


1: Guilt tripping. Manipulators try to guilt trip you for the smallest things, or non-problems. For example: You: “No Isabella, I can’t buy you anything right now, I’m saving my money to help my grandma!”
Manipulator: “Oh, so you just don’t care about me?” You: “I never said th-” Manipulator: “No, it’s fine! Of course you care about your grandma more than your OWN girlfriend.” They’ll try to make you feel bad for doing the things you think are right.(If your significant other is like this PLEASE leave them immediately😭)


2: They’ll make you feel bad for not letting them do something that’s completely weird, or that might make you feel uncomfortable. Example: You: “I don’t think you should be going to a strip club.” Manipulator: “Why not? It’s not like I’m gonna cheat on you. Don’t you trust me?” You: “You shouldn’t be looking at other women like that!” Manipulator: “Tch, you’re so insecure!” This is also like guilt tripping you.


3: A manipulator will make you feel like they’re doing YOU a favor just by being with you, example: “I could just leave y’know…” or, “I wish I never met you honestly.” It’ll make you overthink everything you’re doing, and whenever you try to confront them they’ll act completely confused! Which explains more in 4.


4: Gaslight, Gatekeep, and NOT girlboss. A manipulator will try to gaslight you into rethinking everything you said, when talking to someone like that, you better write down every toxic thing they said, which they’ll probably just say “I never said that!” So voice record them, or make a video of it.


5: When arguing with a manipulator, they might bring up old things that you did to make what they did seem “less”. Even when they promised not to bring it up again, they’ll do it anyway.


6: Also, when arguing with a manipulator, when you try to confront them about what THEY DID, they’ll say “Name one time I did that!” And then *poof*, your memory is gone. Idk how that works it just DOES.


7: Love-bombing…(I’m afraid I’m a lovebomber…. I'M NOT A MANIPULATOR THO I PROMISE.) Manipulators tend to lovebomb to make you feel close to them, only to break you in the end. Saying things like, “You’re the only I felt this way with!” Or, “We have to be soulmates!” They act like you’re the only one when they’ve probably told millions of people the same thing.(AGAIN, if your significant other does anything like these, LEAVE THEMMMM)


8. They’ll make it seem like they’re the most perfect person in the world, like they’re the only ones who don’t make mistakes. “I’d never do that to you!” Or, “Why would I lie to you?” If you ask them a question like, “Were you out with someone last night?” They’ll ask a -question instead of answering, like. “Why would I do that?” Or, “Why would you even ask that? I’d never do something like that to you!” And add extra, unbelievable words like, “never.”


9: The flirt. Some manipulators use flirting to get their way in life. They want to be admired and to have an audience. However, your feelings and needs are of no concern to them.


10: Multiple reasons. A manipulator may have several described excuses, and they’ll switch based on which benefits them most. For example I’ll use my parents. “No you can’t do that, you’re still a kid!” “You aren’t a kid anymore, stop doing that.”


11: Changing the subject. Sometimes a manipulator will change the subject when their behavior is addressed, example: You: “Last week you kept flirting with that waitress, and anytime I tried to address it you just shrugged it off! Or ignored me.” Manipulator: “Weren’t you flirting with another waitress to get back at me? That’s far worse and petty, you should check yourself before you come at me.”


12: False concern. Manipulators act like they care but they don’t, and they way they show their care can be poor. Example: “Hey, I heard that you were sick! I’m so sorry, can you help me with ___?”


13: And finally, a manipulator will make you feel stressed and unhappy, like everything you do is never enough, or that maybe you do too much. Anytime they see you happy they’ll say something or do something that’ll make you feel differently. 


This is how manipulation works. What they say: “I know I did this, but what about when you did that?” - Distracting you by shifting blame on you.
“I know I did that, but trust me, I am not a bad person!” - Undermining and dismissing their mistakes by confusing and tricking you.
“What I’m doing is perfectly normal. It’s you who is inexperienced!” - To demean you into complying with what they want you to do.
“I did that for you! Can’t you do this for me?” - Guilt and shame you into doing things you don’t want to do.


4. The Difference Between a Narcissist, Psychopath, and a Sociopath.


Narcissist: Not every narcissist is a psychopath.
When a narcissist does something abusive, they are concerned about their social image & try everything to keep their real self hidden.


People become narcissistic because of the environment in which they grow with some genetic influence.


Can feel shame, jealousy, greed, regret and guilt(to some extent), needs excessive admiration and often have extreme or unrealistic fantasies of ideal power, money, success, etc.


Psychopath: Every psychopath is a narcissist.
They don’t feel any guilt or shame regardless of what crime they do or commit.


Psychopaths are born the way they are. Are born cold, callous, ruthless, fearless, egocentric(thinking only of oneself without regard for the feelings or desires of others) Grandiose, with superficial charm, manipulative, pathological liars, with lack of empathy, guilt, and remorse.


Sociopath: Sociopaths could be narcissistic.
Sociopaths are also careless. They do things undercover to avoid unnecessary attention.
People aren’t born sociopaths, they too, are shaped by the environment and childhood experiences.
They are a downgraded version of a psychopath. They may have limited albeit weak capacity to empathise or to feel remorse.

1. Writing Angst ^^


I’m pretty good with writing angst(at least I think so..) and it’s honestly pretty easy, the tips I usually do is listen to some songs that make me feel sad or emotional while I write it so it takes a bigger effect on me.


Whatever emotion you’re feeling while you write is how the story will go, at least that’s how it goes for me. Anyways, you need to be in a pretty good or sad mood to write angst. If you’re bored or don’t feel like writing, DON’T WRITE, it’ll make your story feel dull and boring, there’s no rush, take your time and write when you’re ready!






OKAY, now for some prompts for writing angst.

2. Tips for writing FIGHT SCENES
A lot of people have hard times doing this, so here I am to help you <333
-the back of the head is very vulnerable, getting hit there can cause serious damage.


-avoid flashy movements to make it more realistic(unless of course it’s like a fantasy or something)


-if you get hit in the jaw hard enough you’ll be down. It’s like a knockout button


-Your body WILL follow your head,(ex. If your head is forced backwards, your body will fall backwards.)


-Your eyes will water a LOT if your punched in the nose, even if it’s not that hard/didn’t hurt


-Getting hit in the diaphragm causes your lungs to spasm and makes breathing hard


-Kidney punches hurt A LOT


-Leave as much as you can for the reader to imagine


-intensify the pace by using short, simple sentences to keep the reader intrigued


-Avoid the passive voice as much as possible


-Include LOTS of sensory information(ringing in their ears, agony of their injuries, ext)


-Read well-written fight scenes and study them


-Do a lot of research to make it realistic(especially if your characters use weapons)

4. How to make a character's death sadder


Wanna make your readers cry and hate you for killing off a character?? Here’s how to do it!!


No.1 Don’t have them die of old age after a fulfilling life. Many people don’t even think of this as sad.


No.2 Leave one major goal unfinished, the more enthusiastic they are about the goal, the sadder. Like think of Eren from AoT, he wanted freedom and never got it. And JJ from OBX, he wanted to get the crown and go on a surfing trip. Sorry for spoilers!






No.3 Give them strong relationships with other characters.


No.4 If you're killing them off in the final fight, don’t give the other characters time to mourn, it makes it sadder. They’re all caught up in the fight and then a character catches a glimpse of the dead body.


No.5 Don’t kill off new characters, it isn’t sad. Like with Junpei and Yuji, he was only there for like what three chapters? I dunno, some people find it sad, but if you want a heavy impact then you need to make sure the readers love them.


No.6 Give them character development then kill them, maybe make that character be mean and rude, then towards the end they’re sweet and kind, then right when things are going well they die :/


No.7 And finally make their last words heartbreaking, or maybe they don’t say anything, they just have a smile on their face.

3. Not sure what to write next??


It’s normal to get stuck when writing a story, so here’s what to do if you’re stuck!

1: Embarrass your protagonist, make them seem weak and vulnerable in some way.


2: Shoot someone, that always takes the reader by surprise.


3: Kidnap someone, or rather, make it seem to your protag like someone has been kidnapped.


4: Have someone kiss the wrong girl/boy/person, especially if you’ve been setting up a romance angle.


5: If this involves parents, have them argue. Push the threat of divorce, even if you know it won’t happen. It’ll make your readers nervous.


6: Have two side characters who are both close to the protagonist get into a fist-fight. This creates tension for the reader, especially if these characters are well-developed, because they won’t know who to root for.


7: Injure your protagonist in some way, or push them into a treacherous scenario where they might not make it out alive.


8: Make your protagonist get lost somewhere(at night in the middle of the town, in the woods, someone else’s house, ext)


9: Spread a rumor about your protag


10: Involve a murder, it can be as in-depth and as important as you want it to be


11: Introduce a new character that seems to prey on your protagonist’s flaws and bring them out to light.


And finally, 4. Small tips to make the reader FEEL THE SCENE


The basics: Sounds, sights, feelings, smells, and tastes… 
Try to think of a more creative and unique environment for the weather: “The sun was really hot that day.” Okay, we know the sun was really hot but what about… “The steaming road nearly burnt her bare feet” Weird example ik, but whatever. 


You need to explain the scene but don’t OVERDO it. No one wants to read no damn 50 paragraphs about how good the wind felt, just 2-3 lines is alright!!
ROMANCEEE
Romance
Advice


When writing romance(or literally any book), it’s important to get advice, whether it’s from your friends or family that know about your book. Ask them what they think, what you should add, or what you shouldn’t do.
IF no one knows about your book, or maybe it’s a secret(like me lol, I write fanfics, why would I EVER tell my parent that i write fanfictions😭)
Then you should get your advice from other places, like online. Maybe Tiktok, Reddit, or Pinterest. See what people like and don’t like, what they want more off and want less of.


You don’t have to do them all, it’s still YOUR story and you decide what you like and don’t. But advice is still important.






Smut
Tips for writing smut, if you don’t write smut(sex scenes) then I suggest you skip this. When writing smut, you might think things like “Oh no what if this doesn’t sound realistic?” Or, “What if I’m not using the right words?” And writing smut(especially as a virgin, with no experience) can be pretty hard. So I’m here to help youuuu <3


Words, nothing’s more annoying than reading a book and they keep saying the same thing over and over. Like I think after saying “He moaned.” for the THIRD time is enough. There are other words, like groan, grunt, hum, whine, whimper, cry out.
And sometimes you don’t need to say it, just show it in dialogue(yk, like show don’t tell.) You could say, “Mmngh, y-yes, just like that ngh!”(I'm sorry 😭) Without having to say “moan”. And don’t forget to stretch some words out to make it sound realistic, like “Fuuck!” Or “Mmmngh.”


Realism, sometimes it’s really hard to know what to say and what not to whenever writing smut ESPECIALLY as a virgin. So I’m here to help ^^, when writing smut do NOT be too lewd or vulgar, it can sometimes turn people off instead of intriguing them. Like imagine your reading and get hit with a “He slammed his penis in her anus.” Like am I reading a medical document??? You don’t wanna use words that are TOO medical, as in penis, anus, or vagina.
The words “Cock.” and “Dick.” Are perfect, you can also say “Boner” Or “Member” . I personally think it’s a little childish and goofy, but you can do however you want !!


Anatomy, another hard part of writing smut is the anatomy, especially if you don’t know much about the anatomy or haven’t done anatomy classes. So I’m here to help youuu >_<


For women, when you reach down the erm… “kitty”... the first thing you feel is the folds. You can use the word “Folds” everyone says it, so dw. With the folds you can tease them, rub them or whatever. Between the folds is the clit, with this part you can rub it, flap the tongue on it, and it’s mainly used for whenever you're eating someone out.
Example: “He flicked his tongue on her clit, watching her eyes roll back in pleasure.” You can use the word “clit” . Clitoris isn’t really a turn on, but clit works! The clit is the most sensitive spot, so maybe if the person is already “close to the edge” you can reach down and touch there to have even more impact.
When you reach down further you can feel the urethra(pee hole), It’s a VERY small hole that NOTHING goes inside of(you probably couldn’t put anything inside if you wanted to.) Nothing goes inside it okay?
And finally, when you reach down more you can feel the vagina. Keep in mind, no one says vagina, it’s too medical and it just doesn’t sound… good? You could say, “front entrance” or “hole” I usually don’t say hole unless I’m making someone’s dialogue but remember, it’s YOUR book, not mine, so write as you wish.
For the vagina, you could put the dih in there, and also fingers or a toy, basically the hole where “things” go inside.


Slowburn

When writing slowburn, make sure to add in day-to-day lifestyle things. It doesn’t ALWAYS have to be about the lover, you can add in things like friends going out, maybe small drama problems. When you ONLY write about the lover, it doesn’t feel like a slowburn, it just goes by fast(and that’s okay if it’s a short book!)
Me personally, when I wanna write a slowburn, I HAVE to add in drama or other things to keep it going. Otherwise I feel like the story is dull.
So here’s some ideas(that include the lover and some that don’t)
1: Drama between friends. Maybe the character’s best friend starts to become toxic, you could add this to make the story seem realistic since a lot of people go through this.
2: Kissing the wrong person. Nothing’s worse than when the love interest or character kisses the wrong person, it definitely makes the slow-burn feel like an ACTUAL slow-burn
3: Jealousy. This can go both ways, whether you're making your character jealous or the love interest, there’s so many ways and ideas to do it!

4: Grades. If the character is in school, or college, you could make them have trouble with grades. It’s a very common thing(especially in high school-college), and makes it feel relatable and realistic to the reader.
5: Parents. I don’t really see books including their parents (at least from the ones I’ve read.) You could add the parents arguing or even thinking about a divorce(Even if it doesn’t happen, it’ll keep the readers intrigued.)

6: Abuse, SA, or SH. These are some pretty bad things, but it also DOES HAPPEN IN REAL LIFE. Whether it happens to the main character or someone else, you could add things like abusive relationships with friends or parents. Being Sexually assaulted or harassed, or even self-harm.




Tropes
Tropes
Helpful stuff and suggestions for your tropes.


Enemies to lovers. 
When writing enemies to lovers, it is VERY important that you write their relationship CAREFULLY. Like there’s no way they’re going from, “I HOPE YOU KILL YOURSELF.” To, “I always loved you.” In six chapters, it’s just not happening. When doing enemies to lovers you need to show some affection.
Like they argue and bully each other, BUTTT sometimes they help each other out, and/or they aren’t COMPLETELY hateful to them.


This works if one is teasing and the other is annoyed. Like let’s say Person A is always teasing Person B. Person B is easily annoyed by Person A and hates him/her/them.


If the enemies to lovers are like… ACTUALLY enemies to lovers, where one is evil and the other is innocent(God I love these kinds of tropes.) Then there are PLENTY ideas on how to make the characters work.


There’s teaser x annoyed
Innocent x sinful
Risky x caretaker
And so much more.


It’s also important on how you write their relationship afterwards, remember it’s STILL enemies to lovers so their relationship when they’re dating can also have bullying and teasing(in a lovey-dovey way, or just for fun, or even they just get annoyed with each other from time to time.)




Dialogue/Quotes/And using said(requested)
Dialogue/Quotes/And using said(requested)
When writing dialogue or quotes it can be difficult to know when to use the right words, like knowing if you said the words, “She said,” “he said,” too many times, if you should add something more, SOOO I’M HERE TO HELP YOU.


When someone is doing an action while speaking you can say,(and this is just an example.) 

“That girl is so lazy. All she ever does is eat, sleep, and watch shows.” Vanessa said as she combed her hair. Or, “You always talk about yourself and never acknowledge the things I like.” I said, fiddling with my fingers nervously.


Honestly it all just depends on what you’re writing in that scene, and how you want things to go. I get that sometimes saying “I said” or “She said” can sorta be repetitive, so if you’re writing two people talking then just don’t add it. Example:


“Why can’t you ever just pay attention to me?” “Because not everything is about you Charles! I have a life too.” It went quiet for a moment, I had never yelled at him so loudly before.


You don’t always have to say “-Said” you can just continue the dialogue and add whatever at the end.


Or we can take some dialogue that I use/say.




I rested my head on his neck, whispering softly. “I think we should take things slow, I don’t wanna rush into our relationship and ruin what we have.” I paused for a moment, my fingers intertwining with his. “If we could just keep things slow and steady now, that would make me very happy.”


See? A whole thing without having to use the words “said.” The thing is, when you feel like you’re using the words “said” too many times, just switch things up a little. If you describe the action of a certain person doing something, then make a quote. The reader will likely think it’s that character.


Example again:


Isaac laced the little girl’s shoes tight so that she wouldn’t fall, “It’s dangerous to run out in the street like that, especially with untied shoes. Be careful alright?” The little girl nodded. “Yes sir! Thank you.”


Anyways, overall it’s okay to use said as long as you don’t go, “I love strawberries!” I said, “Strawberries are my favorite, we should pick them together.” My younger sister said.


Like a better way would be, “I love strawberries!” I exclaimed. My younger sister grinned brightly, “Strawberries are my favorite, we should pick them together.”


I hope this helped your question, if it didn’t then don’t hesitate to tell me why it didn’t fix your problem, how it didn’t. And what you’d like me to fix, this is a safe space so please don’t feel uncomfortable to request anything!!










Writing the first chapter !!
HOW TO START THE FIRST CHAPTER BECAUSE IT’S ALWAYS HARD FOR SOME REASON?!


For me, writing the first chapter can either be REALLY fun or completely INSUFFERABLE. Sooo I’ll be here to help you guys who relate !!
So first off, you need to GRAB the reader’s attention when you start it off. Start off with something angst, or drama, or even a simple piece of dialogue that makes the reader go like, “OH YEAH, THIS IS ABOUT TO BE GOOD.”


Soooo how do we do that? Well here’s how I usually start mines off(reminder that I do fanfiction sooo some things may be a little different) Ahem, anyways:


“You wouldn’t even be in this position if it weren’t for me! Don’t forget who was there for you when he wasn’t”


Yeah I felt a little corny writing that but oh well, this piece of dialogue RIGHT at the beginning will grab the reader’s attention IMMEDIATELY, and that’s what you want.


Also, when writing your first chapter, make sure you have a GOOD idea about what’s going on, how you want it to go, and so on. Trust me, you don’t wanna write just to write, I’ve tried it before and those stories have been left unfinished because I didn’t know where I was going, what the story would be like, and how it would end.


Have a nice foundation to start on and write from there, ask yourself “What is this story about, and what is the plot?” “Who is the intended audience?” “Where will this story take place, and where will it end?” and “Why will this story be good?” And the first chapter isn’t always going to be “perfect” it’s the VERY FIRST CHAPTER, so you don’t need to keep going back and editing it over and over. The audience isn’t asking for “perfection” they’re asking for entertainment, well writing, and whatever else you’re writing about. Just do your best !! Writing improves over time >.<
Requests !!
For everyone that requested something for me to give tips on, they are here. If you wish to give a request leave a comment and/or send me through email, thank you. 


I don’t know how to name this, but if you’re writing a scene where two best friends(or anyone) is reuniting after a long while, then I’ve got tips for you!!  


(starting off with friends) First off, you wanna make it emotional and real. Put yourself in your character’s shoes, if you were reuniting with your best friend for like 5-6 years, how would you feel?


It also depends on the setting, I’ll just give an example, if your characters are meeting in a library maybe you could have them glance at each other a few times before realizing. Especially if they haven’t seen each other for years, a lot can change about a person in 5 years. 
Maybe give a classic squint like: 
Character A: *Looking for a book and then turns to their right to see character b. Character a squints a few times before speaking up* 


Now, what do they say? It can be pretty hard writing this part because like… where do we start? Don’t worry, I got you. 
Let’s say they give each other a huge hug, or maybe shake hands depending on how close they are. After that let’s move on with a conversation like: 


“How have things been?” “It’s been forever since I’ve been able to see you.” Or, “I’ve missed you!” 
Okay okay, we’ve got that… but where do we move on? 


Of course we gotta build up that relationship again, have them yap for a while about things that have gone while they were away, you don’t have to write the entire dialogue just say “They talked for ___” Or whatever.(Unless you personally want to, remember that it’s your story!)
Maybe have them plan days to hangout or anything! 


If you’re planning on doing it in an angsty way maybe you could have them shed a few tears before running into a hug, I can’t really tell you how to write angst, that kind of thing is unique and everyone writes angst differently so just do you! 
Now, what if we aren't writing about friendship? What if it’s a couple? Well that changes a few things. When they meet, especially if it’s been a VERY long time, they– 


FINISHEDDD
That’s all!! I hope you enjoyed this, if you have any questions then you can ask them in the comment section of the pin. Other places to contact me, Email: Freddlayla@gmail.com(no that isn’t my real name, it’s an alt acc lol) Pinterest: @RRUSKII, Anyways I love you all, don’t worry too much when writing, all you gotta do is practice, no one starts off perfect. And btw I’d love to read your stories when you finish them, if there are too many requests idk if I can do all of them but I’ll try! Anyways you have a great day/evening/night




I can’t wait to see how you become, future authors ^^

⭐ How to Make Your Own CBMagic Link Using FreeDNS
Want a custom URL you can bookmark or share? Here’s the simple way to do it.
________________


🔹 Step 1: Sign Up on FreeDNS
1. Go to freedns.afraid.org

2. Click Sign Up

3. Make your account and verify your email

   * If your school blocks email verification, use a temporary email via the CBMagic proxy (e.g., 10minutemail.com).

________________


🔹 Step 2: Create Your Custom Link
      1. Log in and click Subdomains in the top menu

      2. Click + Add

      3. Pick a domain from the dropdown

      4. Type your custom name (your subdomain)

      5. Click Save/Add

Your link will look like:
yourname.chosen-domain.tld
________________


🔹 Step 3: Point It to CBMagic
         1. Find your new subdomain and click Edit

         2. Change the Type to A

         3. Set the IP to:
144.217.77.9
 (Or use a CNAME pointing to server.ajh.wtf)

         4. Save your changes

________________


🔹 Step 4: Wait for DNS to Update
This usually takes a few minutes (sometimes up to an hour).
Once it updates, visiting your custom link will bring you straight to CBMagic.
________________


🔹 Step 5: Use & Share Your Link
            * Bookmark it for quick access

            * Share it with your friends — flex your custom CBMagic link 😎

________________


✅ Quick Summary
What You Did
	Why It Matters
	Created a FreeDNS account
	So you can manage custom domains
	Made a subdomain
	Gives you a unique personal link
	Pointed it to 144.217.77.9
	Connects your URL to CBMagic
	________________

               1. Go to https://freedns.afraid.org/

Note: some Google Workspace organizations (your school/district) blocks outside mail.                   1. After logging in, click Subdomains on the top menu

                  2. Click the + Add button to add a new subdomain

                  3. In the dropdown, pick a domain

                  4. Type your custom name in the subdomain box

                  5. Click Save or Add

SUBDOMAIN.DOMAIN.TLD

                     1. Find your new subdomain in the list and click Edit

167.86.103.140

DNS changes take a little time (usually a few minutes to an hour) to update. When ready, your new link will take you to Vault !

Self Hosting Guide
You are free to fork and self-host the NettleWeb website if none of the links work for you. It is strongly recommended to do this at home. Your activities could be tracked easily if you are using a managed device or network.


To do so, simply follow the steps below. If you have problems, you could ask for help on our Discord support channel.


1. Create a GitHub account if you don’t have one already.
2. Go to NettleWeb’s official repository and click ‘fork’ at the top-right corner. (Please also click the star button. It helps a lot with Google search ranking.)
3. Change the repository name to ‘username.github.io’ where ‘username’ is your actual GitHub username.
4. Click ‘create fork’ and wait for the process to complete.
5. On your forked repository, go to settings->pages.
6. Select branch ‘Main’ and click save.


Your self-hosted website should now be accessible in the URL shown.
Don’t forget to update your fork frequently to match the upstream, otherwise you might not be able to connect to the backend and use features like proxy and ChatGPT.


If you are still unable to connect to the backend, please see the backend mirroring guide below for workarounds.




Backend Mirroring Guide
If the default backend server is blocked within your network environment, you could create your own backend mirror by following the instructions below. Seeing a ‘disconnected’ message next to the logo is usually an indication of this.


Note: Using an outdated mirror or fork could also result in seeing ‘disconnected’. If you are using a mirror, update it to the latest version first.


NOTE: If only the frontend website is restricted (which happens more often), please use the embed code or self hosting guide instead.


1. Create a Cloudflare account if you don’t have one already.
2. Go to the ‘Workers & Pages’ section on the left side menu and click the ‘create’ button on the top right to create a new application.
3. Select ‘workers’ on the top and click ‘create worker’ then click ‘deploy’ to create a new worker.
4. Click the ‘edit code’ button at the top right corner. Save the URL provided under the preview section.
5. Copy and paste the code below and click ‘deploy’.


export default {
        async fetch(req: Request): Promise<Response> {
                const url = new URL(req.url);


                url.protocol = "https:";
                url.host = "service.nettleweb.com";
                url.hash = "";


                const res = await self.fetch(url, {
                        body: req.body,
                        method: req.method,
                        headers: req.headers,
                        redirect: "follow"
                });


                return res.ok ? res : new Response(void 0, { status: res.status, headers: {} });
        }
};


6. Go to the frontend website with a ‘disconnected’ text. Click the settings button at the bottom right corner and paste the URL saved above to ‘backend URL’. Refresh the page and you should see ‘connected’.


If you need more help on creating a Cloudflare worker, please refer to the official documentation or ask for help within our Discord support channel.

name: Doc 034 — Noah's Sigma Stories
body:
﻿Noah's Sigma Stories
-Make a story about a ship dynamic that you like-


Indiscriminate agent of chaos and dumb x Pure embodiment of good and smart


---


        Clay is a being sent through dimensions to cause chaos to the earth. Jade is a being sent through dimensions to save the world from Clay. In a turn of events, both of them connected. Their missions stayed the same, but they were inseparable.
#
        Jade was in the study of their house when their phone started to ring. They picked up the phone as usual and listened to the other side. As usual, it was Clay.
        “Get to the basement! I have something to show you!” Clay said excitedly.
        Jade sighed. It was common that Clay would call about small trinkets they made to aid with his evil plans which Jade quickly puts a stop to, But this was different. As Jade went down the cylindrical elevator to the basement, (Clay watched too many villain movies) they were greeted with a large figure covered in a large tarp.
        “Ta-Da!” Clay exclaimed.
        “What the heck is it?” Jade asked, a bit confused
        “It’s an interdimensional portal!” Clay said like a small child showing you their crayon drawing.
        “And what are you going to use that for?” Jade asked
        “Probably stealing or something!” Clay said grinning ear to ear like a kid in a candy store.
        “Oh, That’s interesting! By chance, how exactly will you steal from people?” Jade said while Clay stands there oblivious to what Jade is doing.
        “I haven’t gotten that far into the plan yet, but just you wait!!” Clay exclaimed.
        "Sometimes I wonder how you even made this lab…” Jade muttered audibly
        “I made this lab from my pure awesomeness, what else?” Clay questioned.
        “I bet so…” Jade said. Jade looked around the large lab. A wall full of TV screens here, a whiteboard with doodles and scribbles there, it was an entire “evil lab” that Clay had built themselves. 
        “If you can figure out how to build a large world ending laser and a plan for mass world destruction, how come you can’t execute that plan?” Jade inquired, genuinely curious.
        “I just do whatever my mind comes up with when I'm bored, and this time it came up with mass world destruction instead of cupcakes!” Clay smiled.
        Jade sighed as they said, “Next time, just stick with the cupcakes. Simple and delicious.”
        “But, it wouldn’t be me if I went with the normal option, would it?” Clay said.
        “No, no it wouldn’t.” and for the first time in a while, Jade smiled a wide, genuine smile.
Jade and Clay were sent here at the same time, but they didn’t meet each other for a while. Jade was in one area, fixing something that Clay broke, and Clay was just there, creating chaos. One day, they met, and instead of a huge anime style battle scene, the two bonded together. Jade gave Clay a challenge, and Clay made Jade’s life actually worth living. It was a symbiotic relationship.
#
While Jade was making breakfast in the kitchen, they came up with an idea.
“Hey Clay, I have a challenge for you!” Jade yelled, hoping their voice would somehow reach Clay. Jade heard Clay’s feet skittering across the hallway as Clay came sprinting to Jade’s location.
“WHAT’S THE CHALLENGE?!?” Clay said like a sugar crazed toddler.
Jade chuckled. “I think you need to express yourself in a non-violent way.’
“Aww, but that’s boring. Clay said dejectedly. 
“How about this? If you finally make something that won’t destroy the world, I’ll help you for a week.” Jade said.
“Oh!” Clay said like a dog who heard their owner say the word park. “Deal.” Before Jade could respond, Clay scrambled to the lab.
        Jade finished making breakfast, and they went down to Clay’s lab. Clay was vigorously writing plans down on his whiteboard.
        “So, What ideas do you have?”

“So basically, a hydra is a mythical tricard that has two heads. It lives in Blackswolo Lake, and even if you manage to cut one of their heads, two more will grow out in its place. When the hydra was finally slain by THE ONE WHO SHALL NOT BE NAMED, they built a  structure to immortalize THE ONE WHO SHALL NOT BE NAMED” Read Lsplash from The Dictionary Of Trycard after Glitch asked him about what a hydra was.
”Why did you want to know?” said Lsplash.
“Because I went to this huge skeleton that looked just like the dragon thing grandpa Crax told me about,”said Glitch.
Glitch, a boy that liked adventures and fantasy, was seated on a couch in his grandpa’s cabin with his friends Lsplash, crimson, rosemary and Neon.
They were just sitting there talking about how they can make areas safe for all living things. “We should just vaporize them using Glitch!” exclaimed rosemary.
“we can’t do that either.”said Glitch “I might 
be able to change the state of a non-animate object, but i can’t change the state of living thin-” beep bop beep bop, “ayo wassup, yeah so there is this tear in the fabric of reality near town central”
“I guess it’s go time.” said Neon. They all ran outside and just stared at Glitch.
”What?” said Glitch. “Why are you all looking at me like that?”
“Weren’t you the one who took care of night-angle” said Lsplash.
“Uhh…” glitch is hesitant.
“Did you lose it again?” said Lsplah
“I may or may not have lost it” said glitch
“I guess we are gonna have to take the bikes today, by the way, YOU are gonna have to do chores for the next 3 weeks,” said Lsplash, pointing at Glitch.
“Aww” frowned Glitch, they all walked the short distance to the bike hangar and got on their favorite bikes.
“Let's leave,”said Lsplash. All of them started their bikes and took off. After some time they were in the city.

“So we're here, '' said lsplash.
“Who is it this time?” asked Rosemary.
“Seems like it’s riptide.'' said lsplash. 
“Where is he?” said Glitch.
“Seems like he’s near… THE HYDRA’S SKELETON!” said Lsplash.
“Oh nos” said Neon.
“We’ve gotta get there fast,” said Glitch.
                                          
“Yo isn’t that the guy… what who was he… it doesn’t matter, he is too forgettable” said someone from the crowd that had gathered around the skeleton.
“QUIET DOWN FOOLS, OR I’LL TURN YOU INTO ONE OF MY OWN” yelled riptide.
“Yeah, sure you will.” said the crowd while rolling their eyes.
“Yep, that was the final straw, ” after saying that, Riptide starts to laugh loudly.

Hello! Welcome to Byte Webdocs. Created by Pixelate (me), this doc is a collection of proxy links and school computer tools.

 https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EykodfhuBJ3r6ZbNpx7Hx1hIv_3Wg0hE0VYmG_3VkKA/edit

Notice: Please use the document tabs to move around this doc.


Current Objectives:
None yet


🪛 Exploits
D11 Reroute [PATCHED]
D11 has been patched, however you may still want to try it.
Notice: This unblocks one tab, but only that tab. You have to do it again on a new tab.
Another Notice: You can go back and forward in pages, but refreshing resets the tab.


   1. Open a new tab with the link: chrome://chrome-signin
   2. Put in google@d11.org for email.
   3. Click “Sign In Options”
   4. Click “Sign in with github”
   5. Scroll down and click “Docs”
   6. Scroll all the way down and press “Ask the github community”
   7. Delete the search prompt and search up google on the search bar
   8. Press google.com in the sidebar on the top right


Common Error:
If you see “Exceeded secondary rate limit” or similar, go back and retry. It may take multiple tries.


Overprint [PATCHED]
Overprint has been patched, however you may still want to try it.
Use this link first:
chrome-extension://adkcpkpghahmbopkjchobieckeoaoeem/manifest.json


Use this one second:
chrome-extension://adkcpkpghahmbopkjchobieckeoaoeem/main.js




When opening links:
You need to put the links into the bar BUT don’t press enter.
Drag the page with your cursor and press enter while the tab is being dragged.
This will move it to a new window and bypass the auto-closing.


Setup:
   1. Go to manifest.json and do CTRL+P.
   2. Set the margins to custom, and make them as small as possible. 
(Image at the bottom of page)
   3. Set the scale to 200.
   4. Click cancel.


Execution:
      1. Open a new tab, and go to chrome://extensions/.
      2. Once there, go to the details of the extension. (Keep this tab open)
      3. Now that the settings are set up, go to main.js.
      4. Do CTRL+P.
      5. Wait until it shows the number of pages.
      6. Duplicate the tab you are on (main.js) by right clicking the tab.
      7. Go to the chrome://extensions/ tab.
      8. Spam “Allow access to File URLS” for a few seconds. (Leave it off in the end.)
      9. If everything goes well, everything should be unblocked.
        
        Important Notes:
      1. If your computer restarts, that will remove the effect and you must do it again.
      2. It tends to stop working after three days of no restarts, after that you must do it again.
      3. It will drain your battery life around three times faster than usual. 
This is because it works by lagging out the extension by processing a lot of background data.
      4. For the same reason, your computer may lag a bit while it is active.

🔆 Toons!!
Toons are playable characters that are purchasable after getting and of both + requirements for the toon




There is 5 categories of toons common, uncommon, rare, and main these are the twisted categories but because there isn't another good way to categorize them we will use that 
🫧 starters+shrimpo
Boxten is a Toon who that isn’t the best (recommended to choose poppy)  
He can be used for free if Poppy is not chosen, or purchased for 250 Ichor if Poppy is chosen. 
His extraction speed ranges from 1.06 to 1.48, making him a good choice for earning Ichor from machines. 
Boxten is a starter








  



Her ability grants a 50% speed boost for 2.5 seconds when attacked This makes Poppy effective at escaping Twisteds and quickly reaching extraction points




She can be used for free if Boxten is not chosen, or purchased for 250 Ichor if Boxten is chosen.
Poppy is also a starter toon.


                        








  





His stats are set to 1, making him slower and worse at operating machines. He attracts more attention from Twisteds due to his passive ability, Bully.


He can be purchased for 100 ichor. But it is not recommended














🎈 common toons
  
  

Looey excels in both extraction and distracting roles. With low Stealth and a powerful passive ability, Looey can effectively distract Twisteds. His impressive Extraction Speed and Skill Check make him a reliable choice for extracting machines


His ability allows him to gain speed when at lower health












She has well-balanced stats, including above-average Movement Speed and an impressive Skill Check stat. 


Tisha can adapt to various roles, supporting her teammates, assisting with Extraction, or being the primary Distractor




















  

  







































  

  

🔍 uncommon toons
Rodger is a logical and inquisitive Toon in Dandy's World, known for his impressive Extraction Speed and unique ability to gather Research. He excels in collecting data from Research Capsules and Twisteds   
His ability allows him to gather 2 times the amount of research he is very popular to use and many people buy him as their first purchase from dandy’s shop


Slow movement 




  





Toodles is one of the initial 12 playable Toons in Dandy's World. 


She is the youngest of Dandy's World and often wants to be a part of the fun.


 roll for a 15% boost to a random stat that lasts for 10 seconds                
3 of her mastery quests are needed to get pebble


  





 Teagan's ability is to turn collected tapes into a heal for herself every 100 seconds 
to buy here you need to buy from dandy’s shop 25 times


She has decent mobility and can be a good support character. However, her extraction abilities are not as impactful as others in the game.










🐱 rare toons
     
Scraps has the best stamina out of any Toon (other than sprout & bobette)


her ability that allows her to escape from Twisteds or quickly traverse to the elevator, as long as another Toon is nearby














 Flutter excels at Distracting with high Speed and a special Active Ability to evade danger, making her ideal for new players


Her ability allows her to dash forward for 0.75 is is an active ability


  
















  



Goob excelling in high mobility and team support as the distractor role


His ability, Hug! pulls teammates towards him, useful for pulling his team members  into the elevator.

Sprout is a Supporter character.  


 His greatest strength is his active ability, Baked Sweets, which allows him to heal any injured Toon within range for 1 heart at the cost of 100 Tapes1. 


Sprout is also a capable distractor due to his high Movement Speed and Stamina

🎉 event toons


☠️ Twisteds
Twisteds are the main antagonists of Dandy's World. They are the corrupted versions of Toons, disfigured by Ichor. Their main objective is to kill the players.
 
Twisteds are the main antagonists of Dandy's World. They are the corrupted versions of Toons, disfigured by Ichor. Their main objective is to kill the players.


Most Twisteds roam the halls of the various floors of the Gardenview Center, wandering aimlessly. Upon spotting a player, they will begin a chase.
 A chase will end if the player is able to remain out of sight for long enough, usually by hiding behind obstructions, or if the 


Twisted successfully attacks the player by coming into contact with them. A successful attack will normally result in one  worth of damage (the only exception being Twisted Dandy), and the Twisted will pause for around 3 seconds, giving the player ample time to run away. 


Any other Twisteds chasing the Toon will still pursue the player, so you must make distance to completely be safe. 


Roaming Twisteds will be alerted by failed Skill Checks and, if nearby, will run towards the source of the noise. They will not exhibit this behavior if they are in a chase when a Skill Check is failed.
common
  





Twisted Boxten is a Common Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of his Research, you will acquire the Blue Bandana Trinket. 


Twisted Boxten is a roaming Twisted, and has no Abilities to aid him. 
Reflecting his average counterpart, his Speed, Detection Range, and Attention Span are all average. 


You should try to get away from his sight if he spots you, so attempt to preserve 40-70 Stamina to outrun Boxten,








  



Twisted Poppy is a Common Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% of her Research, you will acquire the Pink Bow Trinket. 


Twisted Poppy is a roaming Twisted that possesses no special Abilities


Reflecting her average counterpart, her Speed, Detection Range, and Attention Span are all average. 
Just like Twisted Boxten, try to get out of her sight if she sees you, and preserve some Stamina in case she spots you




















  



Twisted Cosmo is a Common Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of his Research, you will acquire the Sweet Charm Trinket
 Since Twisted Cosmo behaves similarly to  Twisted Poppy and  Twisted Boxten, he has no special mechanic
 so the strategy for Twisted Cosmo 
Generally, avoid his line of sight, preserve Stamina in case he sneak attacks from around corners avoid dead ends to not get hit or killed


 It is also worth noting that he is more difficult to see in Blackouts, due to his primarily dark colour scheme, so you should be more cautious if he spawns on a Blackout floor




  







Twisted Looey is a Common Twisted found in Dandy's World.Upon 100% completion of his Research, you will acquire the  Clown Horn Trinket.
being that he has increased attention span and detection range, without loss of speed. Despite this, he is still just as common as other Common Twisteds, so be more careful whenever he is on a floor compared to others.
 Other than that, he has no special abilities, so just stay further out of his line of sight, and preserve around 50 to 100 Stamina to escape him if he spots you
























  









Twisted Shrimpo is a Common Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of his Research, you will acquire the  Brick Trinket.


Twisted Shrimpo possesses no special Abilities. Reflecting his Toon Counterpart, his Speed is far slower than most other Twisteds, only being faster than  Twisted Finn.
 However, his Detection Range and Attention Span are greater than most, which makes him a uniquely difficult Twisted to shake off at times. Try to turn corners quickly and keep your distance. 


He is one of the easiest twisteds to survive .










  





Twisted Tisha is a Common Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of her Research, you will acquire the  Feather Duster Trinket.
Twisted Tisha is a roaming Twisted that possesses no special Abilities, unless you want to count her abnormally long idle time, as she stops to sweep the floor with her feather duster. 
This means she can camp Machines or passageways, and could be somewhat annoying in runs where there are no Distractors, or while playing a solo run. 
Just like with other Twisteds, you should preserve some Stamina and generally avoid her, and try to get out of her sight if you are spotted. In a situation where she is idle around a Machine, you can try to lure her into a different area or wait for her to move on
Her idle state lasts for exactly 10 seconds.
uncommon
  



Upon 100% completion of her Research, you will acquire the  Spare Bulb Trinket. 


Twisted Brightney is a roaming


 Twisted easily made visible by her red glow, which can be seen even through walls. She is somewhat like  Twisted Poppy,  Twisted Cosmo, and  Twisted Boxten, so simply just trying to get out of her line of sight will work.


 She gives off a red glow, so knowing whether or not she's close is easy, especially on Blackouts.


 Because of her Ability, If a Blackout occurs when there's dangerous Twisteds on the Floor, then all you can do is hope for the best. This Twisted has a slightly higher Attention Span than an average Twisted, so keep that in mind if trying to lose her in a chase.






  

 
Twisted Connie is an Uncommon Twisted in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of her Research, you will get the Ghost Snakes In A Can Trinket.Twisted 
Connie has two states, upon entering a new floor and seeing her, she will take a transparent blue appearance and wanders around aimlessly. In this state, she will not attack Toons. You can gather Tapes and Research by going near her without being harmed, similar to Twisted Glisten. She will continue wandering around, temporarily possessing one machine at a time near her occasionally, producing a blue smoke cloud when transitioning. If she possesses a completed machine, it will give an appearance of almost completed progress but will still contribute towards the completion count. If the machine is uncompleted, its percentage will stay the same. If however, she possesses a machine as a player is doing it, the progress will be up to wherever it was before being possessed. There are three indicators of a machine being possessed without already knowing beforehand:The 3 lines of a machine handle will be upside down in the shape of a right-side-up .The handle of the machine will rattle.The light at the top will flash blue. A cloud of blue comes out of the machine and she come out of the machine
  

Twisted Finn is an Uncommon Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of his Research, you will acquire the  Fishing Rod Trinket.
Twisted Finn leaves a trail of Ichor wherever he moves, making him easier to expect when behind him. He is generally a slow and easy Twisted to deal with as long as you aren't the one to finish the last Machine. When this Twisted is present on the Floor, it's recommended to prime the Machine closest to the Elevator Make sure that you inform your teammates about this-Twisted Finn's Slow III Debuff can be a problem during Panic Mode, so this Strategy ensures survivalTwisted Finn's height and color make him harder to spot in Blackouts than most Twisteds. It's good to have a Toon that can highlight where he is (like  Vee or  Brightney in blackouts) to avoid running into him. His abysmal speed can cause him to appear in places you don't expect or lose aggro and circle back. Keep your guard up if you don't currently know his location.




  









Twisted Razzle & Dazzle is an Uncommon Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of their Research, you will acquire the Ribbon Spool Trinket.
Twisted Razzle & Dazzle is a Twisted that can appear on a random place of the map with a circle of vines. This Twisted can be harmless, and you can even be in their line of sight and will not attack you as long as you are careful.
Twisted Razzle & Dazzle has 2 states passive and hostile 






















  













If you or another player sprint in their circle, they will become hostile and shoot vines at the player from below, dealing one heart worth of damage. If in the circle, regardless of the player’s speed it can still attack if previously aggravated. If a player doesn’t run in their circle in a time of 15 seconds, they will return to their idle position.






















  









Twisted Rodger is an Uncommon Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of his Research, you will acquire the  Magnifying Glass Trinket. 
This Twisted has the ability to disguise as a research capsule based on his investigative nature of his counterpart, waiting for any tricked player to grab it. When this succeeds, he inflicts two debuffs on that collector: Slow III and Confused III to reduce their escaping and extracting time before he could finally attack with his plasma beam eye, giving a heart's worth of damage to any Toon hit. As he is stationary, he has a 360-degree line of sight, waiting for a Toon to enter. If nobody is in his range for a few seconds (~18), he will sink back to his usual disguise.




  



Twisted Teagan is a Uncommon Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of her Research, you will acquire the Fancy Purse Trinke
Twisted Teagan is a roaming Twisted similar to other Twisteds who wander the halls aimlessly. Reflecting her Toon Counterpart's ability, she will steal a fourth or an eighth depending on how many Tapes you have when she hits you. If you are doing a Dandy Run, she isn't too big of a threat due to Tapes having little worth, unless you are playing as Teagan herself, or as Sprout












  





Twisted Toodles is an Uncommon Twisted found in Dandy's World. Upon 100% completion of her Research, you will acquire the Dog Plush Trinket.Twisted Toodles is a roaming Twisted that possesses no special Abilities. Reflecting her childish counterpart, her Attention Span is weak and she can easily lose track of the player. However, she is the third fastest Twisted in the game and easily one of the biggest threats on any Floor. Thankfully, making 3 sharp turns normally shakes her off your trail, so use this to your advantage!If you plan to distract her, losing her line of sight is barely a problem with her speed. Though, distracting with four-star movement speed can still be tricky even with Dog Plush and Speedy Shoes, as you are just slightly faster than her. Using Pebble is a great choice to keep distracting steadily, even in Panic Mode.

Twisted Dandy is currently the only Lethal Twisted found in Dandy's World for now. Upon 100% completion of his Research, you will acquire the Dandy Plush Trinket, which gives a 50% discount on all Dandy's Shop items. Twisted Dandy is a massive, dangerous roaming Twisted that wanders the halls aimlessly. Reflecting his enigmatic counterpart, he has a unique spawning condition that must be met before he has a chance to spawn: Players must not buy any item from Dandy's Store for at least three Floors that he appears on. Each time every surviving Player skips a shop, Dandy will become increasingly upset. Upon skipping the third shop in a row, Dandy will become angry and Twisted Dandy will have a chance to spawn at a rate of 20%. On every subsequent shop Players skip, this chance will increase: on the third time that you continue to ignore him, the music in his Shop will stop playing, and Twisted Dandy is almost guaranteed to spawn on the next Floor. Furthermore, the TV in the elevator will flash with Dandy's logo when he is going to spawn. Once this occurs (or if a Player purchases an Item from his Shop), he will go back to his cheerful self, and Players must skip another three Shops in order to have a chance at spawning Twisted Dandy again.Twisted Dandy continuously emits the sound of a distorted version of music box 'Clair de Lune', and he makes stomping noises as he walks. These sounds are loud enough that they can be used to determine his location and if he has spawned on a Floor. When a Toon completes any Machine. Dandy will flock straight to the finished machine’s location unless preoccupied by a chase.

🏃 tips and tricks
1. make sure you pick up a useless item first, then pick up a useful item on the back of your inventory before Twisted Gigi comes on random floors or if you found Twisted Gigi. If you encounter Twisted Gigi, she will steal the useless item first, but make sure you stay away from her stealing your useful items you have on your inventory. If your useless item is stolen, pick up another useless item to protect the useful item on your inventory from getting stolen by Twisted Gigi. So save the 3rd slot in your inventory for eject buttons, bandages, health kits, box of chocolates, soda pops, etc so gigi can’t steal them  


2. solo runs give you lots ichor than a run with other people. Sometimes solo run will give you a chance to get rare items so you will stay alive longer and get a chance to find twisted mains faster. If you die on 10+ floors on solo, you can get 400-500 ichors or more, because the more you survive each floors, collecting researches, completing machines all alone will get you more ichor


3. Do not use Connie on dandy hunt (except if you have a distractor on your team). You probably know because of her ability. She can hide from twisteds by using her ability to become invicible. But if lethal twisted still can see her if she uses the ability when she is chased by a lethal twisted. Her movement speed is slow, so you better have a distractor on your team. But you don't have to worry about it if you have a distractor and you would be scared if a lethal twisted chasing you but distractor, because Connie has 5 star stealth. So, you can extract machine as fast as possible. You'll be cooked if you're gonna do Connie solo and found Twisted Dandy


4. if you use Brightney, you probably need her to unlock Vee, so... Brightney's stealth would still stay 0, and of course Diary trinket will not gain effect on her stealth. So, if you want to complete mastery quest on her, make sure to hide if you see a twisted coming to find you. And also, stay away from distractors distracting twisteds, so those twisteds won't chase you. So, you have to be careful, find an object to hide from twisteds, like crates, shelves, couch, etc. You must be far away from twisteds
















  

The Daily Twisted Board makes one Twisted have a higher chance of spawning for 24 hours one day starting at 12am GMT. Any Twisted can appear on the Daily Twisted Board, excluding Common and Lethal Twisteds. Currently, the board is occupied by Twisted Glisten


The Daily Twisted Board improves the chances of the selected Twisted to spawn ONLY after the rarity of the Twisted that will spawn has been chosen. For example, if Twisted Pebble is on the board, and the Main rarity is chosen to spawn (normal chance), Pebble's spawn chance will be doubled. If the Uncommon rarity is chosen, Pebble's spawn chance will still be zero

Google Docs doesn’t natively support embedding or running JavaScript and HTML within a document in the same way that a web page might. However, there are a few workarounds depending on what you're trying to achieve:


### 1. **Embed Code Snippets**:
   - **Use code blocks**: You can embed HTML or JavaScript code as plain text within Google Docs by using a code block format.
     - Select the text you want to format as code.
     - Go to `Format` > `Paragraph styles` > `Normal text` > `Code`.
     - This will format the text as a code block, making it clear that it’s code.


   - **Use Google Docs Add-ons**: There are add-ons like Code Blocks that can help format and present code snippets in a more readable way.


### 2. **Embed an HTML File**:
   - **Link to an HTML file**: You can upload an HTML file to Google Drive and then link to it within your Google Doc. 
     - Upload the HTML file to Google Drive.
     - In Google Docs, use the `Insert` > `Link` option to link to the HTML file.


### 3. **Use Google Apps Script**:
   - **Custom Google Apps Script**: If you need to run JavaScript, you can use Google Apps Script, which allows you to write and run custom scripts for Google Workspace applications, including Google Docs.
     - Open Google Docs.
     - Go to `Extensions` > `Apps Script`.
     - You can write and execute JavaScript within this script editor, which can interact with the document.


### 4. **Embed Interactive HTML (Workaround)**:
   - **Use Google Sites**: If you need to display interactive HTML and JavaScript, consider creating a Google Site with the interactive content, then embedding the Google Site into your Google Doc using a link or iframe (the iframe would only work if you view it in a browser that supports it).


   - **Screenshots**: If the interactivity isn’t necessary, you could take a screenshot of the HTML and JavaScript output and embed it as an image.


### 5. **Use Third-Party Tools**:
   - **Lucidchart or Draw.io**: Tools like Lucidchart or Draw.io can create diagrams or visual representations of HTML/JS, which can then be embedded in Google Docs as images.

How To Make Links (Fastly)


Make links with Fastly
Go to  https://fastly.com 


Go to sign up for free


Create an account


For First name, Last name, company/roles, you can put anything, it shouldn’t matter
For your email, you could use a temporary email provider like TempMail or SmailPro so you can create more links in the future, and its much safer.


Verify your account


If you are using temp mail, go to the site and an email should be there.


Now log in to your account


Go to https://manage.fastly.com/home 


On the left hand side bar, click on CDN


On the right top corner, click “Create service”


For the service name, it doesn’t matter put anything.


For the domain, put some text followed by .global.ssl.fastly.net (unless you own another domain)


For example, proxysite.global.ssl.fastly.net (be creative, some domains might be taken already)


For the origin (host), put a link to an unblocker site. It doesn’t have to be unblocked, but it has to be functional and reliable. Don't put a link with a path, like example.com/page.


For example, for Svzy Central I used byod.szvy.website/
If you want an astroid link, use https://astroid.gg/
For Rammerhead, use https://browser.rammerhead.org/


Then press Activate.


Ok, now press "Edit Configuration" and click "Clone Version 1 to edit"


On the left side, go to "Settings" and scroll down to "Fallback TTL"


Set the Fallback TTL to 0 seconds.


Now scroll to the top and press Activate.


Test your link now. After half a minute, it should work.


If you site says, Error 503 Backend unavailable, connection timeout that means the link you put it for the host does not work, so you should try another that is functional.

Types of Proxy Servers
1. HTTP Proxies– These are used for web browsing and are great for tasks like web scraping or managing multiple social media accounts.


2. Transparent Proxies- These are often used in businesses or schools. They don’t hide your IP Address but they can control internet usage and block certain websites.


3. Anonymous Proxies- These hide your IP Address and provide a level of anonymity, but the server might still know you are using a proxy.


4. High Anonymity Proxies- These provide the highest level of anonymity. They hide your IP address and don’t identify themselves as proxies.


5. SOCKS Proxies– These are more versatile as they can handle all types of traffic, not just web browsing. They are often used for gaming or torrenting.


Advantages of Proxy Servers
It keeps things private as it hides your IP address.
It unlocks the web. It can help when you are blocked from watching a YouTube video or visiting a website because of where you live.
Some proxy servers store web pages so if you or someone else is using the same proxy server to visit that page again, it can load faster because it comes from the proxy server’s storage.

Disadvantages of Proxy Servers
Not all proxies are created equal. Many don’t have encryption which means if someone hacks into the proxy server, your data could be up for grabs.
Because your data has to make a pit stop at the proxy server before hitting the open road of the internet, sometimes things can get a bit slow.
Proxy servers are a bit like a one-trick pony. They reroute your internet traffic and don’t have extra features like VPNs offer.

1.    ˚ ༘♡ ·˚꒰ INTRO ꒱ ₊˚ˑ༄
What is CLAW?
CLAW is a Doc where I just write down random things. It has some Anime and Manga. There will be a G@me page too, :) There are some additional inspiration tabs for anyone stuck with something.
Everyone is a commenter, so you can give me recommendations and suggestions. If we have more than 10 nukes-then I will take away this feature. Nobody here is above or below anybody. 
 A pink and purple circle with a green ball in balancing on the left bottom part of the ring. 

	

	2. Why did I make CLAW?
Because of Mob psycho 100, of course!!  I’ve rewatched it so many times, so it’s hard for me not to fall in love with its story-and more importantly, its characters! Also, my friend ((Fwed)) inspired me to do this-as well as one of my siblings. Anyways,, In simplicity, Why not? Might as well give it a shot, right? I think it will be very cool to have a new and unique doc design!
	

3. More About CLAW:
The name “CLAW” comes from Toichiro Suzuki’s organization, CLAW.. aha..um. Can you tell who’s one of my favorite characters? Anyways.. In the show, there’s SCARS, DIVISIONS, and  THE ULTIMATE 5. In the Anime, SCARS are people who try to fight Suzuki, but fail. In this doc, SCARS are Editors. DIVISIONS are different types of structure to run the organization. DIVISIONS in this case, are just tabs. :)
	

	  

	

  

	

	4. Goals:
I don’t have any real high hopes for this doc, I just want to express myself creatively and like it in my own way-however, it would be crazy if one day, some of these goals come true!
   1. This getting somewhat popular?

💙 INPAG
INPAG
───────── ✦.⁺.✦.⁺.✦ ────────
As we know, INPAG has “disbanded.” And no matter how many times I can reread that, it still doesn’t feel real.
INPAG wasn’t just a doc or a community, it was something that genuinely meant a lot to me. It was a place I could go to every day, a place that felt alive with creativity, effort, and people who actually cared. A place where I could express my style and my likes. And somehow, we even made it far enough to win the Winter Awards. I still can’t believe that. We really built something that special together. I’d call myself an “OG” editor, because I was there when everything was at its peak, when the energy was.. THERE, when everyone was motivated, and when it felt like nothing could really go wrong (or stop us). Watching it slowly fade, and now seeing it gone completely… It hurts more than I expected. It feels like losing a place that understood me. INPAG was where I found my start in editing. Before that, I didn’t really know where I fit creatively. But through that community, I learned, I improved, and I found something that I truly enjoyed. More than that, I found people. Real connections. Conversations I’ll never forget. Moments that, even if small, meant everything at the time. It was my safe space. A place where I didn’t feel judged, where I could just be myself without overthinking it. I could put my ideas out there, express my creativity, and feel like it actually mattered. And for someone like me, that meant more than I can fully explain. Even now, I’m not just sad, but I’m grateful. Truly grateful. Because not everyone gets to experience something like that. Not everyone gets to be part of a community that makes them feel seen, heard, and valued. INPAG gave me that. It gave me confidence, memories, and a sense of belonging I didn’t know I needed. 
Thank you, Fwed, for everything you did, for creating something that brought so many people together, even if it didn’t last forever. And thank you to everyone I met through INPAG. You all showed me that my life isn’t just about grades or expectations. that I have meaning, creativity, and a place somewhere in this world.
INPAG may be gone, but what it gave me isn’t. And I’ll carry that with me, always.

Preamble
We, the members of LITE, establish this Constitution to promote independence in learning, freedom of thought, creative expression, and balanced access to technology. LITE exists to empower individuals to grow beyond restrictive systems while maintaining responsibility, curiosity, and respect for personal development.
________________


Article I — Purpose
LITE is founded to:
1. Encourage learning beyond traditional limitations

2. Support intellectual freedom and self-directed growth

3. Allow healthy access to technology, games, and digital spaces as tools for creativity, problem-solving, and community

4. Foster balance between education, enjoyment, and personal autonomy

________________


Article II — Rights of Members
All members of LITE are guaranteed the following rights:
   1. Freedom of Learning

Members may pursue knowledge in ways that best suit their interests, pace, and strengths.

   2. Freedom of Access

Members are entitled to reasonable access to digital tools, platforms, and games as forms of learning, exploration, and recreation.

   3. Freedom of Expression

Members may express ideas, creativity, and opinions without unnecessary restriction.

   4. Freedom of Time

Members may manage their time responsibly, balancing productivity and enjoyment.

________________


Article III — Responsibilities
With freedom comes responsibility. Members of LITE agree to:
      1. Use technology ethically and responsibly

      2. Respect others’ learning paths and personal boundaries

      3. Avoid harm, exploitation, or misuse of access

      4. Continue personal growth, curiosity, and self-improvement

________________


Article IV — Education Philosophy
LITE recognizes that learning:
         * Is not limited to classrooms

         * Can occur through games, technology, collaboration, and exploration

         * Thrives when curiosity replaces restriction

Education under LITE values understanding over memorization and creativity over compliance.
________________


Article V — Balance & Well-Being
LITE promotes a balanced lifestyle where:
            * Productivity and play coexist

            * Mental health and enjoyment are respected

            * Rest and recreation are seen as essential, not distractions

________________


Article VI — Evolution
This Constitution is a living document and may evolve as learning, technology, and society change—so long as its core values of freedom, empowerment, and responsibility remain intact.
________________


Closing Statement
LITE stands for a future where learning is liberating, access is empowering, and individuals are trusted to grow.

We, the students, in order to foster a more engaging and collaborative learning environment, do hereby establish this Constitution. Recognizing the importance of both academic rigor and enjoyable learning experiences, we affirm our commitment to promoting inclusive educational practices that embrace the potential of games as a tool for growth, creativity, and camaraderie.


┊ **Article I: Purpose**  
Section 1. The purpose of this Constitution is to advocate for the incorporation of games as a means of enhancing our educational experience.  
Section 2. We acknowledge the valid concerns regarding the management of distractions and commit to using games responsibly and appropriately within the educational framework.




┊ **Article II: Rights of Students**  
Section 1. All students shall have the right to engage in educational activities, including the use of games, that facilitate learning and foster collaboration among peers.  
Section 2. Every student has the right to express their views regarding effective learning strategies, including the potential benefits of game-based learning.  


┊ **Article III: Responsibilities of Students**  
Section 1. All students are expected to maintain a respectful attitude towards their teachers and peers, utilizing games solely as educational tools.  
Section 2. Students shall be responsible for adhering to the guidelines established by school administration regarding gaming activities.  
Section 3. Each student must accept the rules and terms outlined in this Constitution, ensuring that their actions align with the broader goals of our educational community.


┊ **Article IV: Engagement with Faculty**  
Section 1. We encourage open communication between students and faculty regarding the integration of games into the curriculum.  
Section 2. Faculty are invited to consider feedback from students about the types of games that can be used to enhance learning while maintaining academic integrity.  


┊ **Article V: Unity and Support**  
Section 1. We shall unite as a student body to support one another in our educational pursuits, recognizing that collaboration is key to our success.  
Section 2. We pledge to help and encourage classmates who may be struggling, fostering an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive


┊ **Article VI: Amendments**  
Section 1. This Constitution may be amended by a two-thirds majority vote of the student body, should new ideas and strategies for improving our learning environment arise.


┊ **Conclusion**  
In signing this Constitution, we, the students. affirm our commitment to enhancing our educational experiences through collaboration, creativity, and the responsible use of games. We believe that together, we can create a vibrant learning environment that balances academic achievement with the joy of learning and friendship. Let us work in tandem with our teachers to build a school culture that values both diligence and play!
